const GRAVITY := 1200.0
const SPEED := 220.0
const JUMP_VELOCITY := -420.0

var player_texture: Texture2D = null
var sprite: Sprite2D
var fallback: Polygon2D
var facing: int = 1
var anim_time: float = 0.0
var current_anim_frame: int = 0
var interact_pressed_this_frame: bool = false
var can_control: bool = true

func set_texture(tex: Texture2D) -> void:
    player_texture = tex

func _ready() -> void:
    var shape := CollisionShape2D.new()
    var rs := RectangleShape2D.new()
    rs.size = Vector2(20, 28)
    shape.shape = rs
    shape.position = Vector2(0, -14)
    add_child(shape)
    var tex := player_texture
    if tex == null and ResourceLoader.exists('res://assets/sprites/player_sheet.png'):
        var res: Resource = load('res://assets/sprites/player_sheet.png')
        if res is Texture2D:
            tex = res as Texture2D
    sprite = Sprite2D.new()
    sprite.position = Vector2(0, -16)
    if tex != null:
        sprite.texture = tex
        sprite.region_enabled = true
        sprite.region_rect = Rect2(0, 0, 32, 32)
    else:
        sprite.visible = false
        fallback = Polygon2D.new()
        fallback.polygon = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-10, -28), Vector2(10, -28), Vector2(10, 0), Vector2(-10, 0)])
        fallback.color = Color(0.31, 0.76, 0.85)
        add_child(fallback)
    add_child(sprite)

func _physics_process(delta: float) -> void:
    if can_control:
        var dir := 0.0
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_A) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_LEFT):
            dir -= 1.0
        if Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_D) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_RIGHT):
            dir += 1.0
        if dir != 0.0:
            facing = 1 if dir > 0.0 else -1
        velocity.x = dir * SPEED
        if is_on_floor() and (Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_SPACE) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_W) or Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_UP)):
            velocity.y = JUMP_VELOCITY
        interact_pressed_this_frame = Input.is_key_pressed(KEY_E)
    else:
        velocity.x = 0.0
        interact_pressed_this_frame = false
    velocity.y += GRAVITY * delta
    move_and_slide()
    _update_anim(delta)

func _update_anim(delta: float) -> void:
    if sprite == null:
        return
    var frame := 0
    if not is_on_floor():
        frame = 3
    elif abs(velocity.x) > 10.0:
        anim_time += delta
        frame = 1 + (int(anim_time * 12.0) % 2)
    else:
        anim_time += delta
        frame = 0
    current_anim_frame = frame
    if sprite.texture != null:
        var rr := sprite.region_rect
        rr.position.x = float(frame * 32)
        sprite.region_rect = rr
        sprite.flip_h = facing < 0

func get_state() -> Dictionary:
    return {'pos': global_position, 'vel': velocity, 'on_floor': is_on_floor(), 'facing': facing, 'anim': current_anim_frame, 'interact': interact_pressed_this_frame}

var recording: Array = []

var interact_pressed: bool = false
var ghost_texture: Texture2D = null
var sprite: Sprite2D
var fallback: Polygon2D

func setup(rec: Array, idx: int, tint: Color, tex: Texture2D) -> void:
    recording = rec
    loop_index = idx
    tint_color = tint
    ghost_texture = tex
    if recording.size() > 0:
        var st: Dictionary = recording[0]
        global_position = st['pos']
    modulate = Color(tint.r, tint.g, tint.b, 0.55)

func _ready() -> void:
    var tex := ghost_texture
    if tex == null and ResourceLoader.exists('res://assets/sprites/ghost_sheet.png'):
        var res: Resource = load('res://assets/sprites/ghost_sheet.png')
        if res is Texture2D:
            tex = res as Texture2D
    sprite = Sprite2D.new()
    sprite.position = Vector2(0, -16)
    if tex != null:
        sprite.texture = tex
        sprite.region_enabled = true
        sprite.region_rect = Rect2(0, 0, 32, 32)
    else:
        sprite.visible = false
        fallback = Polygon2D.new()
        fallback.polygon = PackedVector2Array([Vector2(-10, -28), Vector2(10, -28), Vector2(10, 0), Vector2(-10, 0)])
        fallback.color = Color(0.61, 0.48, 1.0, 0.55)
        add_child(fallback)
    add_child(sprite)
    z_index = 2

func advance() -> void:
    if playback_index < recording.size():
        var st: Dictionary = recording[playback_index]
        global_position = st['pos']
        interact_pressed = bool(st.get('interact', false))
        var anim := int(st.get('anim', 0))
        var facing := int(st.get('facing', 1))
        if sprite != null and sprite.texture != null:
            var rr := sprite.region_rect
            rr.position.x = float(anim * 32)
            sprite.region_rect = rr
            sprite.flip_h = facing < 0
        playback_index += 1
    else:
        interact_pressed = false

func get_playback_time() -> float:
    return float(playback_index) / 60.0
